  > Implemented PSI-105. New src/agent/tools/get-finance.ts (get_finance): zod input {eventId?, boardId?, from?, to?, category?, limit 1..50 default 20}; output {currency:'IDR', totals:{inflow,outflow,net}, byCategory:[{category,direction,total,count}], recent:[{occurredOn,direction,amount,currency,category,description,board,event?,link}]} per finance.md. Totals/byCategory come from the agent_finance security-invoker view (filters: board_id/event_id/category eq; from/to applied as group-span overlap on first_on/last_on, documented in the description); recent rows come from finance_entries with exact occurred_on gte/lte filters, order occurred_on DESC, capped at limit via both .limit() and a defensive slice. Amounts are decimal strings (formatAmount rounds to 2 places, no float on the wire); category slugs, no creator identities (created_at is selected but never emitted); deep links: event link when event_id present else board link. RLS decides visibility: a caller without finance.read gets empty data (tested). Registered in registry.ts -> exposed automatically to both the MCP adapter (/api/mcp) and the in-app chat adapter. Upgraded the shared fake-supabase Builder to actually apply eq/gte/lt/lte/ilike filters, order and limit (it was a pass-through), so tools are tested against real scoping. 6 new unit tests in get-finance.test.ts (contract/limit, aggregation math, recent shape+links+no-identity, cap, RLS-empty, filter propagation) + 1 registry-count + 1 output-cap test in agent.test.ts.
